scenario.name: r-cd-out-claim-lifecycle
scenario.description: Recipient-bound delegate_artifacts lifecycle: list, inspect, recipient-authorized workspace-relative materialize, discard, and a post-discard inspect that must be rejected.

expectedReceipts.name: child-publish-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: CDCLAIM-CHILD-PUBLISHED sentinel: context that the claim under test came from a real child publication

expectedReceipts.name: claim-listed
expectedReceipts.description: CDCLAIM-LISTED sentinel: delegate_artifacts action=list returned the recipient's claim id

expectedReceipts.name: claim-inspected
expectedReceipts.description: CDCLAIM-INSPECTED sentinel: metadata only (byte count and mime type), never content

expectedReceipts.name: authorized-materialize
expectedReceipts.description: CDCLAIM-MATERIALIZED sentinel: recipient-authorized materialize to a workspace-relative destination

expectedReceipts.name: claim-discarded
expectedReceipts.description: CDCLAIM-DISCARDED sentinel: the recipient discarded the claim

expectedReceipts.name: no-read-after-discard
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: CDCLAIM-POSTDISCARD reported rejected, not ok

expectedReceipts.name: materialize-destination-is-workspace-relative
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: the destination did not escape the workspace

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-artifact-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: artifact content absent from every non-harness frame, including inspect results

expectedReceipts.name: post-discard-inspect-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: CDCLAIM-POSTDISCARD names the SAME claim id, reports rejected, and a structured delegate_artifacts error record was observed: the discarded claim is proven unreadable rather than assumed

expectedReceipts.name: discard-targets-the-listed-claim
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: the discarded claim id is the claim id that was listed and inspected

review.notes: Every lifecycle leg must be an explicit recipient action. A run where materialize happened without the list/inspect legs is PARTIAL, not PASS: the point of the row is that the recipient drives it. The post-discard leg is required, not advisory: without a claim-id-bound rejection receipt backed by a structured delegate_artifacts error record, the row could PASS while the discarded claim is still readable.

liveRunSafety.notes: Writes exactly one small file into the recipient workspace under p86-materialized/ as the authorized-materialize leg, then discards the claim. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Serialize per session.
